text.description_html:
RK International HK-5822, Two-Prong Porcelain End Polished Brass Hooks

When you pay attention to little details, you can see how it they really pull a look together. The Polished Brass Hook with White Porcelain Tips can add a sense of opulence to a home, its ornate grandeur coming not from a heavy style, but from the classic beauty of white porcelain with brass. It has two prongs, to make sure hats and coats stay together. But this hook can be used in a lot more places than by the front door. Hang in the bathroom for towels, in the kitchen for your apron, or in the closet to hang your purse collection.

Specifications of the Ornate Polished Brass Wall Hook:

  • Material: Brass with porcelain tips.
  • Length: 5"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 3-5/8"
  • Packaged with matching finish screws.

Sold Individually
